manifest.Hamiltonian: sum K_ij ZiZj - Gamma sum Xi - h sum Zi; PBC
manifest.pure_definition: constant guide psi_T(s)=1; uniform initial samples
manifest.network_definition: frozen seed501 psi_T=sqrt(p); initial samples from p
manifest.estimates: mixed energy; four-replica forward-walking q2 and connected chi
manifest.uncertainty: SE across four independent populations; all cycles retained
manifest.timing: propagation plus guide sampling; excludes cache loading and creation
manifest.cost_limit: network uses L2 lookup; direct inference overhead excluded
